description: This file declares classes and functions related to GStreamer source element implementation within the Rialto media server. It includes class definitions for GstSrc and its factory, along with associated methods and internal structures, as well as external dependencies and macros.

classes.name: GstSrcFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing GstSrc instances, with singleton pattern and thread safety.

classes.name: GstSrc
classes.description: Implementation of the IGstSrc interface, managing GStreamer source element setup and configuration.

methods.name: getGstSrc
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the singleton GstSrc instance.

methods.name: setupAndAddAppArc
methods.description: Configures and adds an app source to the GStreamer pipeline.

methods.name: allAppSrcsAdded
methods.description: Finalizes setup after all app sources have been added.

methods.name: createPayloader
methods.description: Creates and returns a GStreamer payloader element.
